justification: Image A depicts an abstract geometric interlace pattern (knotwork circles and a triangular pendant motif) with no figurative content, while Image B depicts a naturalistic anthropomorphic figure with a masked face, multiple limbs holding weapons (spear and bow), and dark hanging tail-like appendages.
